title: Ils ne sont pas marxistes: r/LeftistsForAI, Marx's Legacy, and the Left's Lost Capacity for Internal Critique
sentence: Writers who expect the composing layer shape their critique in advance to pass it: the archive's own SEM-PROBE documentation (#208, AXN:0008, line 156) states "The phrase is research infrastructure, not ideological content." A left that cannot hold its internal critique now faces a mediation layer that holds the whole critical tradition, issues it on request, and leaves the work of carrying it to whoever will.
